instructions_to_main_agent: Install `react-fast-marquee` or standard CSS keyframe marquee for smooth kinetic text ribbons if needed, or use Framer Motion loop.
Include Google Fonts links in `public/index.html` for 'Outfit', 'Syne', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono'.
Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling or smooth native behavior is initialized with Lenis library (`@studio-freight/lenis` or standard smooth scroll handling).
Set dark mode as default background on `<html>` and `<body>` tags.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid="nav-contact-btn"`, `data-testid="hero-cta-button"`, `data-testid="agent-simulator-trigger"`).
Use standard SVG graphics for the custom logo mark and favicon.
Replace the splash screen marker in App.js cleanly.
Implement clear responsive breakpoints so mobile views remain sleek with drawer or mobile nav overlay.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain flat gray backgrounds. Use layered depth, subtle borders (`border-white/10`), ambient radial glows, and crisp micro-borders.
Avoid Inter for headings. Use Outfit or Syne for Display headlines.
Ensure high text contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large display headlines).
All interactive elements MUST contain `data-testid` attributes.
Hover states MUST explicitly declare both background AND text color changes.
